rows.title_full:
AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF TAX RACKETEERING, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES
THEREOF, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 257 OF THE NATIONAL
INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short:
Defining The Crime Of Tax Racketeering, And Providing Penalties Thereof, Amending For The Purpose Section 257 Of The National
Internal Revenue Code Of 1997, As Amended
rows.abstract:
Aims to restore public credence and reliance on official receipts or invoices - that these are principal pieces of evidence for consummated transactions and are essential for tax compliance.

Proposes for several provisions regarding the following:  

Defines tax racketeering as any coordinated scheme or operation to evade or defeat any tax imposed under the Tax Code through the fraudulent use of receipts, returns, and other records, with a minimum amount of Php10,000.000.00 in taxes avoided; Increases the penalties imposed for willfull attempts to evade any tax imposed . . .; Includes the acts of distributing, acquiring, using or aiding in the use of unauthorized, fake, or falsified transactions documents and other accountable forms as punishable. . .; Automatic revocation or cancellation of license and registration certificate if the offender is a CPA; Penalties upon conviction of tax racketeering; Public officials as an accomplice who aid and abet the commission of tax racketeering.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-05-29, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-05-30 and received by the Senate on 2023-05-30

rows.title_short: National Land Use Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to provide a policy for the rational and just allocation, utilization and management of our land resources including the parameters that will guide planning at the national and local levels.
Proposes for the following:   Provides a national framework for the development of the country´s land to ensure their optimum use, consistent with sustainable development principle; Creates the National Land Use Commission/Office; Establishes the composition of NLUC; Harmonizes existing rules and regulations governing the management of land resources; Addresses the vital issues of agrarian reform, climate change, national database and geo-hazard mapping and disaster risk reduction and management; Incentives and awards to LGUs that regularly updates their comprehensive land use plan, etc.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT PENALIZING THE SMUGGLING OF FOREIGN CURRENCY AND OTHER
MONETARY INSTRUMENTS IN BULK INTO OR OUT OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Anti- Bulk Foreign Currency Smuggling Act
rows.abstract:
Requires any person or entity engaged in period transfer of bulk currency under money service business to register with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
Requires incoming or outgoing passengers bringing in or out of the Philippines foreign currencies or foreign currency-denominated bearer monetary instruments in excess of Ten Thousand US Dollars (US 10,000.00) or its equivalent to accomplish the Currencies Declaration Form and Customs Baggage Declaration Form. 
Mandates the Bureau of Customs (BOC) to submit the declaration to the AMLC within twenty-four (24) hours upon receipt thereof for purposes of conducting an investigation.
Enumerates certain acts as evading the currency declaration requirement.
Allows the BOC to immediately seized the foreign currency or foreign currency-denominated bearer monetary instrument upon discovery of the fraud pursuant to Section 1113 of RA No. 10863, otherwise known as the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA).
Criminalizes bulk cash smuggling.
